mapper.select:
select file_id as fileId, /*文件id */ file_type as fileType, /*文件类型 */ file_name as fileName, /*文件名称 */ file_path as filePath, /*文件路径 */ '' as 备注, /*备注*/ DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as fileTime /*文件时间 */ from BOK_FILE_INFO where file_type in ('05','07','08')
AND (file_name like concat_ws('','%' , #{fileName} , '%'))
and create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fileTimeBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
and create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{fileTimeEnd},'%Y-%m-%d') + numtodsinterval(1,'day')
